name: Tarvik Relicsmasher
description: A giant who dreamed trinkets and machines caused all woe, and renamed himself.

description_citations.text: Shadowmoor: card flavor text (Shadowmoor, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The giant Tarvik dreams that trinkets and machines cause all woe and takes the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.
timeline.quote: When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.
